# File Upload

File Upload is an experimental component and can be used to select one or several files on your computer and upload them to a server.
The component let you upload the files with a Button or by dropping files on a dedicated area. File upload **can only be used as controlled component and not uncontrolled**.
See [File Upload guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/file-upload/design/)

For the retry button to be visible please set "retry" to true in the respective file object.
